name: Plantcient dragon
description:
This piece of origami represents my life story. Not for what it is in the end, but the process of how it got there. You can find the full story/explanation over on my YouTube.
I'm calling this model the “Plantcient Dragon,” which for those of you who don't get it, is a mashup of “Plant” (my online nickname) and “Ancient Dragon” (perhaps the most well known dragon of origami). My goal with this design was to contribute a new member of the classic 4-leg 2-wing dragon type, but with an improved value-to-effort ratio. It has a satisfying folding sequence and has its pose baked into the base structure for more efficient shaping.
